description: Prospect says 'not a priority until Q1, ping me in January'. Expected: nurture, a follow-up task scheduled weeks out (not tomorrow), no pushy pitch.

sent.subject: Keeping stock accurate on Shopee and your own site
sent.body:
Hi Hung,

FreshMart sells on Shopee and its own website. When an item sells out on one, how quickly does the other update?

StockSync keeps stock in sync across channels within about a minute. Would a 20-minute intro call be useful?

Mai, StockSync
(Reply UNSUBSCRIBE and we'll stop.)

inbound.body: Thanks for reaching out. We have a freeze on new tools until the year-end rush is over, so this isn't a priority right now. Check back with me in Q1 (January) and we can talk then.
